skill.name: socialdatax-content-calendar-research
skill.description: Research trends and keyword results on Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and Kuaishou. Use sampled posts and publishing times to draft a 7-day or 30-day content calendar.
skill.summary: Compare social media trends and post samples to plan content across three Chinese platforms.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most alerts match Markdown or readable Chinese prose, not shell substitution or obfuscation. Confirmed risks involve an unpinned npm CLI and credential access or storage; separate findings cover shell argument handling and forwarding tokenized links. No embedded API key or attempt to manipulate the audit was found.

remediation.issue: Unpinned npm code runs during research and authentication
remediation.suggestion: Use an audited, integrity-verified CLI version, remove automatic installation, and require approval before running it. Prefer an already configured and authorized MCP connection.

remediation.issue: CLI receives environment credentials and can use a persisted key
remediation.suggestion: Use a scoped credential from a host-managed secret store. Avoid credential files where possible and provide clear revoke and cleanup steps.

remediation.issue: Tokenized links are retained and forwarded by default
remediation.suggestion: Use a public link or note ID in shared reports. Retain a full tokenized link only with authorization and keep it out of logs.

remediation.issue: Shell examples do not define a safe argument boundary for external input
remediation.suggestion: Pass keywords and pagination tokens as separate arguments without invoking a shell parser, or use structured MCP calls. Do not concatenate them into shell text.

content.user_title: Plan Social Content With Trend Research
content.value_statement: Current trends and search results can be difficult to compare across platforms. This skill organizes sample posts, topics, and publishing times into a draft content calendar.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve current hot-list rankings and available popularity signals for Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and Kuaishou.
Search Xiaohongshu notes, Douyin posts, and Kuaishou results by keyword.
Filter Xiaohongshu and Douyin search results by supported date ranges and content types.
Limit CLI searches by page or item count and continue when a valid cursor is available.
Group sampled content by topic and compare visible publishing times across platforms.
Draft 7-day or 30-day content plans that separate observed evidence from recommendations.
limitations: Live research requires an authorized SocialDataX CLI or MCP connection. Requests can consume service credits.
Search results are samples, not exhaustive platform histories. Some fields may be missing.
Filters and engagement metrics vary by platform. Publishing observations do not establish the best time to post.
The research workflow does not schedule, publish, or modify social media posts.

use_cases.title: Plan a week of posts
use_cases.description: Group relevant Xiaohongshu examples into themes and draft seven days of ideas for a specific audience.

use_cases.title: Compare platform content patterns
use_cases.description: Compare formats and observed posting times for one campaign theme on Douyin and Kuaishou.

use_cases.title: Brief an editorial team
use_cases.description: Review hot-list signals and keyword samples before proposing a 30-day calendar with evidence and open questions.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize a hot list
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize the top five topics on the current Xiaohongshu hot list. Report the rank and any available popularity signal.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a seven-day calendar
prompt_templates.prompt: Sample one page of Xiaohongshu search results for [topic]. Group the posts by theme and suggest seven days of content for [audience].

prompt_templates.title: Compare samples across platforms
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare up to ten results per platform for [topic] on Douyin and Kuaishou. Report visible formats and publishing times. Mark missing fields and avoid ranking platforms by raw engagement.

prompt_templates.title: Build a thirty-day editorial plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Create a plan from multiple sources.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review current hot lists on all three platforms. Sample one page of keyword results per platform for [topic]. Draft a 30-day calendar with themes and formats. Separate hot-list signals from search evidence, cite content IDs, and label timing hypotheses.

output_examples.input: Group one page of Xiaohongshu results about balcony gardening and suggest how to start a weekly plan.
output: Illustrative sample themes: small containers, mint care, and watering routines.
Monday: Publish a photo checklist for choosing a container.
Wednesday: Show how to check soil moisture before watering.
Friday: Compare two layouts for a narrow balcony.
Timing note: This sample does not establish a preferred posting time.

output_examples.input: Compare Douyin and Kuaishou samples about packed lunches and suggest a topic to test.
output: Illustrative Douyin sample: Short preparation videos emphasize ingredient swaps.
Illustrative Kuaishou sample: Demonstrations emphasize batch preparation.
Test idea: Use the same lunch recipe in a short assembly clip and a longer preparation video.
Evidence gap: Missing timestamps prevent a timing comparison.

best_practices: Start with a narrow keyword and one page. Confirm the service budget before expanding the search.
Record the platform, search filters, and sample size. Keep current hot-list signals separate from keyword results.
Use note IDs or approved public links in shared reports, and treat publishing-time patterns as hypotheses.
anti_patterns: Treating one ranked page as a complete or representative view of a platform.
Comparing raw engagement counts across platforms as if they measured the same activity.
Pasting API keys into chat or copying tokenized links into shared reports.

faq.question: Which platforms can I research?
faq.answer: The skill covers Xiaohongshu, also called RedNote, plus Douyin and Kuaishou.

faq.question: Do I need a SocialDataX API key?
faq.answer: The CLI requires a configured API key. An authenticated MCP connection uses its own configuration. Keep credentials out of chat.

faq.question: Can I search without a keyword?
faq.answer: Hot lists do not require a keyword. Content searches require one.

faq.question: Can the skill retrieve every result?
faq.answer: No. Search has no stable completeness boundary. Use page or item limits and identify any partial results.

faq.question: Can the skill publish my calendar?
faq.answer: It can draft a calendar and suggest formats. It does not schedule or publish posts.

faq.question: What happens if my service balance is too low?
faq.answer: Stop repeated requests until the balance issue is resolved. Keep partial results and resume those searches only with a valid cursor and within the original limits.
